release_notes: B275 adds a configurable 60-minute local buzzer auto-rearm and uploader-battery audible reminders. When auto-rearm is enabled, a manually disabled buzzer master automatically returns ON after 60 minutes and also restores ON after restart. When auto-rearm is disabled, the buzzer master remains OFF indefinitely. With a valid uploader battery reading, battery below 20% gives a 2-second buzz every 5 minutes, while battery at or below 5% gives a 5-second buzz every 2 minutes. Clinical glucose and NO DATA alarms retain priority. B274 TFT/button safety, multi-CGM support, trend backfill and OTA remain unchanged.
